# Ingersoll Heating & Cooling

> Ingersoll Heating & Cooling is a local HVAC company serving Ingersoll, Oxford County, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.

Phone: (519) 485-2371  |  Email: contact@ingersollheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://ingersollheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Ingersoll, Woodstock, Tillsonburg, Norwich, Thamesford, Embro
